Implements the complete grounded RAG application and Windows-compatible Kubernetes delivery platform. Versioned indexing publishes Chroma generations; three API replicas share Redis conversations/cache, validate citations, and refuse unsupported answers. Hardened images, persistent workloads, network policies, probes, autoscaling, and SHA-tagged CI/CD provide the deployment path.

Validation: 305 local pytest cases plus types, lint, UI, coverage, manifest, scan and real/fixture cluster evidence. Development CI passed. This same PR demonstrated a real evaluation regression: an intentionally incorrect fixture relevance floor .99 caused recall@5=0 and blocked the required gate. The correction restores the validated .65 value; golden questions and baseline remain unchanged. Required CI must pass before merge.

Protection enforces PRs and seven strict GitHub Actions checks for administrators. Jibran explicitly requested zero required approvals; the assignment's independent-review criterion remains unmet. Docker Hub secrets are configured privately; actual SHA publication/CD will be verified after merge. See docs/evidence/platform/P05 for original logs and API evidence.
